title: Fourier concentration at the Friedgut degree
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ and let $\varepsilon>0$. Define the degree $d$ to be the ceiling of the total influence of $f$ divided by $\varepsilon$. Then the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients indexed by subsets of size greater than $d$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
